text: The Canada Labour Code applies to all employers and employees in Canada, including those governed by provincial labour legislation.
Under the Canada Labour Code, a strike includes a slowdown of work designed to restrict output.
The Canada Labour Code applies to federally regulated industries such as railways, air transport, and banking.
Under the Canada Labour Code, a lockout includes the closing of a place of employment to compel employees to agree to terms of employment.
The Canada Industrial Relations Board is established under the Canada Labour Code.
The Canada Labour Code applies to radio broadcasting stations.
Under the Canada Labour Code, collective bargaining is the foundation of industrial relations in the federal sector.
Provincial governments are subject to the labour standards provisions of the Canada Labour Code.
